tonight.headline: No starter in doubt; Pickens will likely play — from your bench
body: Bad news first, and it sits on the bench: George Pickens is still questionable (shoulder, hamstring) after three limited days — Schefter now says he is expected to play. He does not start here by projection (14.0 to Tuten's 14.8 in the flex, a coin flip), so it costs nothing either way.
44.1 banked from Thursday's Jacobs and Golden; ESPN 60%. No IPADE starter is on any Week 8 list. The lineup as set is the projection lineup — nothing to do.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Jacobs 23.2 and Golden 20.9 final. Five starters at 12:00 CDMX, Daniels 19:20, Loveland Monday 19:15. Metcalf Gala have everyone left.

case.label: This morning's news
case.body: Pickens expected to play (Schefter, 1 Nov). Colts willing to trade Taylor before 10 Nov (NFL.com, ESPN, Yahoo) — he plays today. Payne season-ending for Washington's defence, not Daniels.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Sunday inactive among the starters, or Loveland out Monday despite no designation.

starting.name: Jonathan Taylor
starting.detail: IND · @ JAX · SUN 12:00 · Daniel Jones · Colts open to trading him before 10 Nov

worthALook.name: KC Concepcion
worthALook.lead: Carried: a real role; a free-agent look, never a claim.

case.label: The player
case.body: Cleveland's Week 7 breakout — 10 targets and 23.2 (archive). At Pittsburgh in Week 8; no Week 8 designation found this run. A free agent: no priority.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Golden out for multiple weeks — then a free-agent add costs no priority. Drop would be Pitts, the third tight end.

worthALook.name: DeMario Douglas
worthALook.lead: A.J. Brown is OUT (ankle/knee, Patriots.com 31 Oct); ESPN and Football Nation name Douglas as the target to use.

case.label: The player
case.body: Brown downgraded to OUT on Saturday; three healthy receivers remain, Douglas in the slot (Patriots.com 31 Oct). 19.6 on 8 touches in Week 6 (archive).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: A one-week vacancy with no multi-week timeline, and he would be a fifth receiver behind Golden, Wilson, Pickens and Rice. A free agent — he costs no priority, so there is no reason to move before the role proves out.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Brown reported multi-week and Douglas above 25% of targets Sunday, or Pickens ruled out for multiple weeks — then a free-agent add, Pitts the drop.

doNotChase.name: T.J. Hockenson
doNotChase.lead: Free, and no longer needed: Loveland was cleared Saturday.

case.label: The case for
case.body: Not on the Vikings' final report (PurplePTSD 31 Oct); Kyler Murray starts; Detroit allow the most tight-end points. He was the Sunday cover for Loveland's neck — a question Saturday's Bears report closed.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 11.3 against Pitts' 10.4 — 0.9, a coin flip. Adding him means dropping Pitts, added on 28 Oct; that seat changed hands inside seven days and nobody in it is ruled out (STRATEGY §3).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland's neck flaring up after Monday, or a multi-week injury to him — then Hockenson for Pitts is a real upgrade, made after Week 8.

doNotChase.name: Woody Marks
doNotChase.lead: Now a free agent, but Houston are on bye and he would be a fifth back.

case.label: The case for
case.body: Every Houston running-back touch in Week 7 (20), briefly leaving with a leg injury; Montgomery (groin) has missed two games and would make it a platoon on return (Fantasy Footballers 25-28 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Cleared to free agency (league file 13:05Z), so no priority — but Houston are on bye in Week 8, Montgomery's return would cut the role, and Taylor, Jacobs, Tuten and Gordon are all ahead. A roster spot is the cost.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Two IPADE backs hurt before Week 9 — then a free add.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage. Every rostered RB and WR is inside the expert top 24; the tight-end bar is not cleared. Seven weeks of data.
